duplicate_identity_policy: SOURCE_BINDING_FAILED if normalized candidate identity is duplicated after Jain exclusion and complete-case projection.

identity_exclusion.limitation: Alias or renamed identity overlap not captured by exact normalized names remains a stated limitation.
identity_exclusion.rule: Exclude GDPa1 rows whose normalized antibody_name exactly matches a canonical Jain candidate_id.

missingness_policy: Primary cohort is complete-case across all nine frozen mapped assays; no imputation and no post-run assay removal.
